about_hero_desc: We believe the future of cities begins with transforming their most traditional layers — where data science, intelligent algorithms, and the passion of a young generation come together.
Who We Are and Why We Started?: Who We Are and Why We Started?
about_story_p1: We are a group of developers, software engineers, and researchers from the Islamic Azad University who gathered under the supervision of the :club. Our main concern was one fundamental question: :question
about_story_q: “How can outdated and traditional parts of the city be transformed with modern software and artificial intelligence?”
about_story_p2: Among all urban arteries, parking management was still run by the patterns of past decades: human error in time and tariff calculation, slow plate entry, long queues, financial opacity, and insecurity in monitoring vehicles.
about_story_p3: We didn't rush into coding to solve the surface of the problem; instead, we spent :research across public, multi-story, commercial, and corporate parking lots. We spoke directly with operators, owners, and drivers, documented the dark bottlenecks of traditional systems, and extracted every challenge that technology could untangle.
one year of deep field research: one year of deep field research
about_story_outcome: Creating :brand — a comprehensive, real-time system, automatic in plate monitoring and secure in license management, giving owners complete parking control with millisecond precision.
about_phase1_desc: A gathering of university programmers and researchers with the mission of making traditional urban structures smart.
about_phase2_desc: On-site review of commercial and corporate parking lots, interviews with operators, and root-cause analysis of human and financial errors.
about_phase3_desc: Designing a comprehensive real-time plate recognition system using artificial intelligence, slot management, integrated financial reporting, and a tariff management system for parking slots.
about_value1_desc: Elimination of human error, recording every entry and exit with photographic documentation, and real-time control of device access levels.
about_value2_desc: Plate detection in a fraction of a second, automatic tariff calculation with a smart Jalali calendar, and connection to barrier gates without delay.
about_value3_desc: Regular updates, 24-hour support, and high flexibility to connect to parking structures of all sizes.
Equip Your Parking with Next-Gen Tech: Equip Your Parking with Next-Gen Tech
about_cta_desc: Contact our team for expert consultation, a technical review of your facility, and a free demo of the system.
privacy_hero_desc: Transparency in data retention, authentication, and protection of your dedicated licenses.
privacy_p1_intro: The AvaPark system stores only the basic, essential information required for authentication and license validation:
privacy_p1_item1: Name, email/username, and encrypted password for secure panel login.
privacy_p1_item2: Identifiers of connected devices and IPs to control the allowed limit of the purchased license.
privacy_p2_desc: The recorded information is kept solely for the user's secure login to their dedicated account, validating the purchased license code, and preventing any misuse or unauthorized use of the user's license and connected devices by others.
privacy_p3_desc: User passwords are stored irreversibly using standard one-way hashing algorithms (Bcrypt). User sessions are also protected with security tokens to prevent intrusion and unauthorized access to the license and user panel.
privacy_p4_desc: AvaPark is committed to never disclosing or selling account information, license details, or device status to any third party or entity under any circumstances.
contact_hero_desc: The AvaPark engineering and support team is with you at every stage of setup, equipment connection, and operational troubleshooting.
contact_card_phone_desc: Handling operational challenges, camera configuration, and field deployment coordination.
contact_card_ticket_desc: Report errors, system logs, or request custom features with precise tracking.
contact_card_email_desc: Official proforma invoices, tenders, business partnerships, and large corporate contracts.
contact_faq_desc: Answers to common questions about how it works, technical compatibility, and AvaPark software licensing
faq_q1: What kind of cameras does the AvaPark AI plate recognition system need?
faq_a1: AvaPark is architected to be fully compatible with any standard network (IP) surveillance camera that supports the RTSP or ONVIF protocol — no need to replace or buy expensive dedicated plate-recognition cameras.
faq_q2: If the internet goes down, will traffic processing and vehicle registration stop?
faq_a2: No. Image processing, plate recognition, and barrier-gate commands run locally (on-premise) on the server inside the parking lot. Data syncs with the cloud server once the network connection is restored.
faq_q3: How are parking tariffs and working hours managed?
faq_a3: The software includes a flexible tariff module with full Jalali calendar support. You can customize entry fees, hourly rates, daily rates, official holidays, and subscriber tariffs with a few clicks.
faq_q4: What is the license management and device connection policy?
faq_a4: Each plan defines a specific limit of simultaneous clients and entry/exit gates. Licenses are validated automatically; when upgrading or downgrading a plan, connected devices are managed with logical prioritization while keeping the system stable.
contact_footer_desc: Our technical support colleagues are ready to answer any question about integration, deployment, and the AvaPark license.
